workload: 1,000,000 GET / through rt.serve, 128 keep-alive connections — the saturation probe: does 4x concurrency raise throughput or just queue?
finding: throughput flat at ~90k rps (90,251 @32c vs 90,347 @128c) while p50 went 346us -> 1485us and p99 608us -> 2429us: the server is saturated — extra concurrency queues as latency, it does not buy throughput. The knee is the single-threaded pull-model dispatch loop, ~11us serialized service cost per request. Zero errors/refused/timeouts at saturation.
